# What api-diff's focus job (and api-probe with [api-focus]) prints straight into its log; the workflows list the kinds
# of line. "datadiff <path>" lines are printed by api-diff's overrides job, 26.3's file against 26.4's.
# Recipes, round 2: 26.4 loads recipes as a registry (Registries.RECIPE), so where the registry loader reads an element's
# file and decodes it, and where the recipe registry is listed.
find ReloadableServerRegistries
calls net.minecraft.server.ReloadableServerRegistries .
calls net.minecraft.server.ReloadableServerResources ^loadResources$|^<init>$|^updateStaticRegistryTags$
member net.minecraft.resources.RegistryDataLoader .
calls net.minecraft.resources.RegistryDataLoader ^loadElementFromResource$|^loadContentsFromManager$
find RegistryDataLoader
member net.minecraft.world.item.crafting.RecipeMap .
